findings.reason: Russian «мой...» is an unfinished affectionate address to her dead husband. Hungarian «én…» becomes an unfinished first-person pronoun, dropping the addressee and altering who the fragment refers to.
findings.proposedTarget: Widow: De téged mégsem tudtalak megmenteni, drágám…
